title: Looking for new Audacious package maintainer
body: Audacious in [extra] has no package maintainer anymore since Evangelos Foutras (foutrelis) has left. How is it handled when a package becomes orphaned? How is a new maintainer searched for in such a case? Who is interested to update Audacious to 4.6 (recently released) and become the new package maintainer? Thanks.
